title: Connect vocabulary to the object and operation
caption: A term becomes useful when it has a place in the manufacturing chain. Materials, processes, devices and systems describe different kinds of thing.

nodes.label: Materials
nodes.detail: Name substances that make or support the chip

nodes.label: Processes
nodes.detail: Name operations that change those materials

nodes.label: Devices
nodes.detail: Name structures that perform electrical functions

nodes.label: Systems
nodes.detail: Name assemblies built from the devices

title: The object changes as the scale changes
caption: A transistor, die, wafer, package and rack are different physical objects. Their dimensions cannot be substituted for one another.

nodes.label: Transistor
nodes.detail: A local switching structure

nodes.label: Die
nodes.detail: One fabricated circuit

nodes.label: Wafer
nodes.detail: The manufacturing surface containing many dies

nodes.label: Rack
nodes.detail: A system assembly containing packaged electronics

title: A node label is not a universal physical measurement
caption: The node reference should be read alongside actual pitches, architecture and manufacturer conventions.

nodes.label: Commercial node
nodes.detail: Names a process generation

nodes.label: Device architecture
nodes.detail: Describes planar, fin or wrapped-channel geometry

nodes.label: Physical pitches
nodes.detail: Measure specified repeated features

nodes.label: Circuit density
nodes.detail: Depends on the implemented cell and routing design

title: Several manufacturing branches meet in assembly
caption: The master flow includes parallel logic, memory and substrate work. It is not one wafer passing through every operation in the course.

nodes.label: Logic wafer and die
nodes.detail: Runs through front end, wiring and sort

nodes.label: HBM stack
nodes.detail: Is made on a separate memory-manufacturing branch

nodes.label: Package substrate
nodes.detail: Is manufactured as a separate connecting structure

nodes.label: GPU assembly and system
nodes.detail: Combines the prepared branches and proceeds toward the rack

title: Follow the supplied object through each purchase
caption: The buyer-supplier view identifies what crosses an organizational boundary: materials, equipment, design services or manufactured components.

nodes.label: Foundry and memory
nodes.detail: Supply fabricated logic and memory

nodes.label: Assembly and test
nodes.detail: Supply integrated and screened components

nodes.label: System manufacturer
